This '''stormtrooper''' was a [[Gender|male]] who served in the ranks of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[3 BBY]], he was stationed aboard [[Imperial Cargo Transport 241|Cargo transport 241]]. It is unknown if he was one of the troopers jettisoned into space by [[C1-10P|Chopper]].<ref name="The Forgotten Droid" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This stormtrooper appeared in "[[The Forgotten Droid]]," an episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-forgotten-droid-episode-guide|text="The Forgotten Droid" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Freddie Prinze Jr.]], who voiced [[Kanan Jarrus]].<ref name="The Forgotten Droid" />
